ask.speaker: Apo
ask.line_en: Lolo, why are you so distant?

reply.speaker: Lolo Berto
reply.line: Tinitingnan ko ang hardin. Alam mo, dati maraming bata rito. Mga pinsan mo. Si... hindi na mahalaga.
reply.line_en: I'm looking at the garden. You know, there used to be children here. Your cousins. And... never mind.

deflect.speaker: Lolo Berto
deflect.line: Matanda na ako. Nagkakamali ng pangalan. Pumasok ka na, apo. Mamaya na ang usapan.
deflect.line_en: I'm old. I mix up names. Go inside, apo. We'll talk later.

end.speaker: Lolo Berto
end.line: Kung may maririnig kang kalampag mamayang gabi — 'wag mong pansinin.
end.line_en: If you hear a noise tonight — don't pay attention to it.
